integrity: Analytical proof for all n>=4, exact Prüfer enumeration for orders four to six as independent finite checks, direct vertex support checks, and fixed-seed spherical Monte Carlo as diagnostics. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns standard unweighted Euclidean embeddings of two spanning-tree zonotopes on the same labelled vertices and their widths along one common spherical direction. Its covariance extremum does not assert a similar Pearson-correlation extremum or any stochastic ordering. The published absolute-Gaussian kernel is credited, and possible earlier equivalent coupled graph-variation statements remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp negative cross-width covariance for pairs of tree graphical zonotopes
